say:2:1030404001:0.text: <hpy>Boss! The grapes from Southville were just a temporary fad!</hpy>
say:2:1030404001:0.source_cn: <hpy>老板！南村的葡萄果然只是一时的风潮！</hpy>

say:3:1030404002:0.text: There are many rules in business and trade. One is that even the prettiest bubbles burst in the end...
say:3:1030404002:0.source_cn: 这是经济发展的必然规律。泡沫再美丽，总有破裂的一天……

say:4:1030404003:0.text:
I see! I need to learn these rules. Well, folks from my town used to feed cows magic potions.
<hpy>They believed their cows would produce banana-flavored milk.</hpy>
say:4:1030404003:0.source_cn: 原来是商业规律！我的家乡以前还发生给奶牛喂魔法药剂的故...

say:5:1030404004:0.text:
Don't get hung up on those tricks that attempt to manipulate the market.
One can always make more money, but a bad reputation is very hard to redeem.
say:5:1030404004:0.source_cn: 别总纠结于那些操纵市场的把戏。\n金钱损失了还能弥补，...
